sections.Profile:
The Robocop pinball machine, released by Data East in 1989, is based on the popular sci-fi action movie of the same name. Designed by Joe Kaminkow and Ed Cebula, with artwork by Kevin O'Connor, this game features engaging elements like a jump ramp, spot targets, eject holes, multi-ball, and more. It stands out with its alphanumeric display and voice call-outs from the movie soundtrack.

- Manufacturer: Data East USA Inc.
- Years made: 1989
- In production: no
- Type: Solid State
